༄༅/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam mdo bcu sogs la brten pa'i 'chi bslu 'chi bdag zhags gcod ye shes ral gri bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal po'i thugs dam mdo bcu sogs la brten pa'i 'chi bslu 'chi bdag zhags gcod ye shes ral gri bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru shrī karma ka badzra dha ra ya/ chos rgyal thugs dam mdo bcu la// brten pa'i 'chi bslu mdo'i lugs// mdor bsdus snying po yongs dril ba// 'chi bslu 'chi bdag zhags gcod dbye// de la sbyor ba bcas bsham kyi rim pa la/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar ston pa'i sku gzugs/ glegs bam gang 'dzoms/ rgyal po mdo bcu gang yod 'dzoms na legs/ ring bsrel ldan pa'i mchod rten/ mchod gtor dkar zlum/ gtsang ris dpal mgon la dkar gtor che legs 'bru sna zas snas bskor ba/ lan chags bgegs rigs la chang bu lo grangs/ khrus bum/ me long*/ khrus lder/ khrus dar/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas bcas rab brgya rtsa/ 'bring nyer gcig /tha ma bcu phrag /mchod yon/ zhabs bsil la sogs mchod pa'i bye brag ji ltar mang na legs/ maṇḍal 'thor nas bcas 'du bya/ stan bde bar 'khod de tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ thub bstod/ gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs chos spyod kyi rigs gang 'grub/ rnam 'joms tshar gcig bklag pas khrus bum bsgrub/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshad med bzhi la blo sbyong ba ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /gsum pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag stobs kyis// snod bcud bde chen zhing gi bkod pa'i dbus// yid 'phrog nor bu'i gzhal med khang chen por// rin chen seng khri pad zla'i gdan mchog dang*// dngos bshams gzugs rigs mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cig

/na mo ratna tra ya ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra pra mardha na ye/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te saṃ myag saṃ buddha ya/ tadyā tha/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzwa badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bho dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bho dhi maṇṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma a wa ra ṇi bi shwo dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gzungs tshar gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta na da swa bhā we na/ badzra dharma hri dā ya santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ ces rol mo byin brlab kyi sngags tshar gsum brjod pas byin brlab/ bzhi pa sa gzhi byin rlabs ni/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍurya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /dpag bsam shing gi skyed mo'i tshal// sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas sras// chos snyan sgrogs pas gang ba yis// phyogs rnams thams cad gang bar shog /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod dgur yang*// byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag /rang gi legs pas sa steng dag /brgyan par mdzes pas bzhugs gyur cig /lus can kun gyi bya dang ni// shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang*// nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra// rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /lnga pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnams sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra e hya hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ

drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ bdun pa gdan 'bul ba ni/ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ brgyad pa khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma yā shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wakka tsitta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dgu pa sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ bcu pa na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog

/dri med mtshan la sgrib bsil mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can kun// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wast+ra a laṃ ka ra swā hā/ bcu gcig pa maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod pas rdul phyi/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che// nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che| dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs tshom bu so bdun ma dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /i dam ratna maṇḍal kaṃ nirya ta ya mi/

sogs bdun nam gang thub dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur te// maṇḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna maṇḍal pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐/ mnyes byed maṇḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /sogs bya/ bcu gnyis pa phyag bya ba ni/ oṃ na mo mañdzu shrī ye swā hā/ na mo su shrī ye swā hā/ na mo utta ma shrī ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun du// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ bcu gsum pa las kyi dngos gzhi ni/ rgyal po mdo bcu gang rung tshar gcig bklag pa'i rjes su 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/

skyabs gnas bla ma mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i bden pa'i byin rlabs bslu ba med pas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge zhes bgyi ba'i dus dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zlog cig /'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod cig /dus kyi pho nya'i khram kha phyes shig /nad gdon bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal bar gyur cig /chos dang mthun pa'i bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de 'dra ba'i bzang spyod sogs mdo bcu gang yin tshar brgya 'gro ba ni las kyi dngos gzhi'o/ bcu bzhi pa las kyi rjes 'brel gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhya/ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas mgron bzhi'i gtor ma chang bu byin brlabs la/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang*// lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad// gza' brgyad rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// gnod sbyin brgyad dang phyogs skyong bcu// 'jigs byed dgu dang rgyal chen bzhi// gtsang ris dpal mgon 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi// dus dang dus min 'chi ba zlog /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur// khram kha phyes la shwa rdil spos// dug rlangs zer ma phog pa sol// gnas rten spos la rang gnas song*// gnod 'tshe gdug pa'i sems spongs la// snying rje byang sems ldan par mdzod/ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni sarba pū dza hoḥ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra i dam ba lingta khā hi/ zhes mchod gtor rten la zhal phyogs/ gtsang ris kyi gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs/

chang bu rnams byin rlabs gong des khyab la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan dang*/ sambha ra lo grangs kyis chang bu snod gzhan du dor zhing chu gtsang sbrengs la/ mchod sbyin 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zad mi shes pa 'di nyid bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas ni/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ nad 'dre lan chags/ za 'dre shi gshed/ pho gdon mo gdon/ sngar 'dre rnying pa/ da 'dre so ma/ yul 'dre 'khyams po/ yas dang glud la gdung ba thams cad la mgron no/ 'bul lo/ sbyin no/ pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med par ngoms shing tshim par gyur cig /grangs mang brjod/ mthar chos bshad pa ni/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ ya la ma wa sha sa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya'o/ rjes kyi rim pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ sogs lan gsum yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ shis brjod ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/

sogs shis pa brjod par bya'o/ 'chi bslu ni/ bzang spyod/ zab mdo/ rnam 'joms/ ltung bshags/ 'da' ka ye shes/ tshe mdo/ gdugs dkar/ gos sngon can/ nor rgyun ma/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma gang rung chog go /zhes pa mkhan ming 'dul 'dzin pa// rnam 'gyur lcags pho stag gi lor/ lto phyir grong chog 'grim pa'i skabs// 'brug thog nyi ldog dus gtor dus// gshin rje'i zor bskul bgyis pa'i nub// mdo bcu'i 'chi bslu mdo yi lugs// mdor bsdus phyag len yi ger thob// dus kyi 'chi ba bzlog nus na// dus min 'chi ba lta ci smos/ ༈ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na yis// gsungs zhes gnyid phug 'bod snang thos// phyir nang dbu bzung zas mda' yi// bu ne tshang du rdzogs par bris// mchog dman kun la sman gyur cig /a mṛ ta bha wantu/
